summary: Tested Remote Sessions page new features: Alert deletion (single and bulk), mapping removal, watcher command ack, and AnyDesk ID visibility. All 16 backend tests pass. Frontend verified: Sessions/Alerts tabs, AnyDesk ID badges always visible, Assign/Edit/Remove mapping controls, Clear All alerts button, individual alert X delete button.
critical_code_review_comments: DELETE /api/remote-sessions/alert/{dedup_key} correctly handles URL-encoded dedup keys with special characters
DELETE /api/remote-sessions/alerts supports both date and month query params for filtered deletion
POST /api/remote-sessions/watcher-commands/ack correctly updates command status to 'completed' or 'failed'
Session cards always display AnyDesk ID in mono font badge regardless of mapping status
Mapped sessions show both 'edit' link and small unlink icon for removing assignment
Mapping form includes 'Remove' button when editing existing mapping
